## File: multi_pane.override.yaml
## Type: tenant UI override
## Purpose: Tenant-level overrides for the multi-pane UI layout (coordinates
## and pane sizing). These values overlay the application defaults.

user_interfaces:
  ui_framework: multi_pane

  panes:
    - id: results_list
      role: list
      coordinates:
        x: 0
        y: 0
        width: 42
        height: 100

    - id: preview
      role: preview
      coordinates:
        x: 42
        y: 0
        width: 36
        height: 100

    - id: version_carousel
      role: list
      coordinates:
        x: 78
        y: 0
        width: 22
        height: 60

    - id: diff_panel
      role: diff_right
      coordinates:
        x: 78
        y: 60
        width: 22
        height: 40
